stepper.$description: Horizontal step indicator for a short multi-step flow — the New Group Message wizard ('1 Select Students — 2 Message Details') is its driving use case. Numbered circles joined by connector lines, each step inactive / active / complete. A complete step's circle fills and swaps its number for a check; the connector leading INTO a reached step fills too, so progress reads left-to-right. Deliberately minimal (no vertical variant, no descriptions) — built for 2–3 step wizards, not a page-length onboarding. 2026-10-27 (from Storybook's Stepper, which is a whole wizard): completed steps can be buttons that go back to that step (navigable, the default in a Wizard; turn it off when a step can't be undone, e.g. after a payment) — upcoming steps never are; below breakpoint.md the row becomes a compact line ('Step 2 of 3 · Time' + a Progress sm bar); and the Wizard pattern around it: one step's Fields at a time, a footer with Cancel (first step) / Back, Next, and on the last step the action's own name ('Book appointment', never 'Submit'). Next is never disabled: it checks the step's Fields like Form does, shows the messages and focuses the first one.

iconSize.$description: The check glyph on a complete step (check.svg, the shared Material icon).

completeColor.$description: The connector into a reached step fills brand blue.

text.$description: The step label beside the circle (14px semibold).

inactive.$description: Not yet reached — a hollow-reading gray disc + muted ink.

active.$description: The current step — solid brand fill, on-fill number, default-ink label.

complete.$description: A finished step — solid brand fill with a check glyph, default-ink label. Same fill as active (it stays 'done and reachable'); the check vs. number is the only difference.

hoverCircleBg.$description: A completed step you can click back to: the disc darkens like a primary Button.

compact.$description: Below breakpoint.md: 'Step 2 of 3' (text.secondary) + the step name (text.default), heading-sm, over a Progress sm bar filled to the step.

wizard.$description: The flow around the Stepper: Stepper, the current step's Fields, a footer.

footerGap.$description: 12px between the footer buttons — Dialog's footer gap; right-aligned, Secondary (Cancel/Back) then Primary (Next / the action).
